about:
RCD Components was founded in 1973 in Manchester, New Hampshire, where it remains headquartered. The company was acquired by Gowanda Components Group in 2019 and became part of the iNRCORE Group in 2020, expanding its portfolio within a broader passive-components manufacturer network.

The company designs, manufactures, and tests precision mission-critical resistors — including wirewound, high-surge, carbon-composition, and custom configurations — as well as inductor products. RCD operates a U.S.-based production facility that added a new laboratory and expanded capacity in 2026, supporting high-volume standard and custom orders with an extensive datasheet library for every listed part.

RCD serves space, aerospace, defense, medical, and industrial markets, supplying engineers and procurement teams at organizations where component failure is not an option. Its resistors are used in satellites, launch systems, radar, communications, missile systems, medical equipment, and industrial automation.

RCD differentiates itself by focusing exclusively on resistors, providing direct access to design engineers, and maintaining a zero-defect culture backed by ISO 9001 certification and ITAR compliance. The company advertises lead times up to three times shorter than competing high-reliability resistor manufacturers, with a SWIFT delivery service that can ship components in as little as three days.
